card.name: Inside names and rare words
card.fires_on: Word endings such as ana, ard, olas, ARA partway through proper names, citations and rare nouns like gondola. Seen mostly in author names and reference lists in general web text.

modes.label: Surname endings
modes.description: Final piece of a surname in a citation or name, such as ana or ard.

modes.label: Gondola endings
modes.description: Final piece of the word gondola in produce handling or travel text.

card.plain: It fires on the closing piece of unusual names and rare words, like surnames in citations or the word gondola.
